content.text: But before you have to remember that, you know, it was basically by telephone or by mail. So actually seeing a person 10 years or catching up with them was very difficult back then.
content.trans: 但是在此之前，你得记住，基本是通过电话或邮寄。所以那时候看到一个人或者跟上他们非常困难。

content.text: Yeah, we we all see photos and videos now of our classmates. So it's not quite as surprising when we go into them later. But I think it is still interesting though because at least on my social networking websites, there are a lot of people that I don't have connections to.
content.trans: 是的，我们大家都看到我们的同学和老师在他们的照片和视频里。所以现在不是那么令人惊讶了。不过我认为还是挺有趣的，毕竟我在社交网络上有很多朋友，他们对我并不熟悉。

content.text: And so I look forward to my high school reunion when I get to see some of these people and find out what they've been doing for the past 10 or 15 years.
content.trans: 我期待着高中毕业后的聚会，当我有机会见到这些人都能了解他们过去十年或十五年的所作所为。

content.text: It's actually very interesting. I guess when you see how your classmates have changed, how maybe the one that used to be the nerd or maybe not a not very attractive. All of a sudden is really attractive and has like a supermodel as a wife or how these things work out.
content.trans: 英语：实际上挺有趣的。我猜当你看到你的同学变了，是不是可能就是那个曾经是 nerdy 或者不那么吸引人的。突然就变得非常有魅力，并且有了像超级模特的妻子或者这些事情是怎么回事。

content.text: Or the high school football captain is now kind of sad and you know, fat.
content.trans: 英语：或者高中足球队的队长现在有点郁闷，你知道，胖。

content.text: So yeah, these are the types of surprises that people look forward to when they go to high school reunions. So a very interesting subject. Let us know on our website, Englishpa.com if your high school in the place where you live, do they have high school reunions or maybe even elementary school reunions?
content.trans: 英语：所以啊，这些都是人们期待在高中毕业聚会时会遇到的惊喜。所以这是一个非常有趣的话题。如果你们住在你们所在的地方，或者甚至是在小学毕业聚会，他们是否也举办过这样的聚会呢？

content.text: Yeah, let us know. We hope to find out more about you guys' experiences and until next time. Bye.
content.trans: 是的，让我们知道。我们希望了解你们的经历，直到下次再见。拜拜。
